summary: Pin is in garden bush; nearest real option is the busy visitor car park to the north-east.
reasons: Ring in dense planting, footpaths only
Visitor car park about 90 m away
Busy attraction with centre and planetarium

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings mapped or visible. The car park sits among gardens and visitor buildings, so it is in the middle of a day-use attraction rather than hidden.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed asphalt car park with marked bays, mapped access yes, no fee. The ring itself has no track, only garden footpaths.
drivers.traffic: Visitor traffic by day; quiet at night apart from any patrols.
drivers.convention: Cars fill the bays in the imagery. Nothing suggests overnight stays.

flags: Slope figure is for the ring (about 12% mean, max 44%); car park not sampled
Car park is well beyond the ring, at the edge of the image
Gardens car park may be gated, lit or patrolled after hours
sun_shade: Open sealed surface in the sun, with garden trees around the edges.

best_section.where: Sealed visitor car park beside the Visitor Information Centre, about 90 m north-east of the ring
